about: The world canary (the lead, 24 November: what CI found red over nine batches, most of it a change that moved every world, found 20 minutes after a push): the world-level walks that catch a province, kit, generator, rule or name moving every world, run by scripts/test-changed.ts whatever their speed when a change can move every world, and alone by `bun run test:canary`. Chosen from the specs CI found red on 24 November, the heaviest few (whole adventures' long plays) left to CI.
